profile_config: 4096 rows, 256-row chunks, OWNRT_PREFILL_PROFILE=1 and SHAPE=1; decode profiling off

floors.note: The byte bound assumes every one of 512 experts is touched in every site; actual distinct experts are fewer. The compute floor uses the dense reuse kernels' previously measured 2.5 TMAC/s. Routed 4.72 s is above both floors, so weight decode/reuse, not an arithmetic or DRAM floor, is the lever.

chosen_mechanism: Add only the already CPU-tested exact 4x8/GRF256 and 2x8/GRF128 grouped-expert configurations; select by the existing family switches. Per-output arithmetic is unchanged.

reuse_model.basis: Prior 256-row route census: 2560 slots over about 440 distinct experts; Poisson occupancy model

prior_attempts: T8 lost at 32-128 rows and was not swept at 256 rows because the earlier card-27 sweep stopped at a fault. This task tests only the unmeasured 256-row regime; it does not repeat decode-kernel or dense-layout attempts.
